mapper.insert: INSERT INTO individual (species_type, algorithm_identity_id, cover_image_path, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{speciesType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{algorithmIdentityId}, #{coverImagePath}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, species_type, algorithm_identity_id, cover_image_path, created_at, updated_at FROM individual WHERE species_type = #{speciesType} ORDER BY id
